data: What is the approximate accuracy value of the red line with circles in the second graph from the left at 0.5 number of questions?

The red line with circles represents the Prob-Acc(qm) for SQLNet on the Dev set. At approximately 0.5 number of questions, the red line with circles reaches an accuracy value of around 0.75. Therefore, the approximate accuracy value of the red line with circles in the second graph from the left at 0.5 number of questions is **0.75**.
